hero.title: File:00 1854 Iguazú-Wasserfälle - Südamerika.jpg
hero.description: Iguazú waterfalls on the border between Argentina and Brazil. The natural wonder Iguazú consists of 20 larger and 255 smaller waterfalls with an extension of 2.7 kilometers. Some of the waterfalls are up to 82 meters high. The picture was taken during a flood (7,000 cubic meters / second).
